bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/menu-idempotent-8dc8d56-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 8dc8d5638e7711688be549acf1127ea5bc09b1c1 || exit 60
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:idem-8dc8d56)" || exit 62
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
record="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT state||'|'||message_id::text FROM board_menu_panels WHERE chat_id=-1003770334893 AND panel_type='posting' AND message_id>0 LIMIT 1" 2>/dev/null || true)"
case "$record" in verified\|*) ;; *) exit 63;;esac
mid="${record#verified|}"
case "$mid" in ''|*[!0-9]*)exit 64;;esac
log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-single-panel.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" run --rm --no-deps -e MENU_PUBLISH_PANEL_TYPES=posting -e MENU_PUBLISH_CHAT_ID=-1003770334893 gaybbs node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs >"$log" 2>&1;then
 python3 - "$log" "$mid" <<'PY'
import json,sys
items=[]
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
 try:j=json.loads(line)
 except ValueError:continue
 if j.get("panel_type")=="posting":items.append(j)
if len(items)!=1:sys.exit(65)
i=items[0]
if int(i.get("chat_id",0))!=-1003770334893 or int(i.get("message_id",0))!=int(sys.argv[2]) or i.get("updated_existing") is not True:sys.exit(66)
print("EXISTING_GAY_POSTING_PANEL_EDIT=PASS")
PY
else
 if grep -qi 'message to edit not found' "$log";then exit 71;fi
 if grep -qi "message can't be edited" "$log";then exit 72;fi
 if grep -qi "not enough rights" "$log";then exit 73;fi
 if grep -qi 'POSTING_DM_FEATURES_NOT_RELEASED' "$log";then exit 74;fi
 if grep -qi 'COMMON_GATE_ROUTE_NOT_VERIFIED' "$log";then exit 75;fi
 if grep -qi 'PANEL_' "$log";then exit 76;fi
 if grep -qi 'MENU_PUBLISH_FAILED' "$log";then exit 77;fi
 exit 78
fi
